description: Toroidal solenoid: R_major=0.15m, R_minor=0.02m, N=100 turns, I=1A. By Ampere's law, B inside = mu0*N*I/(2*pi*r). B outside should approach zero.

checks.note: B = mu0*N*I/(2*pi*r) = 4pi*1e-7*100*1 / (2*pi*0.15) = 1.3333e-4 T. 2% tolerance for N=100 discretisation.
Outside torus (r=0.30m > R_major+R_minor=0.17m): |B| must be near zero by Ampere's law.
